english.title: Prohibited movement for sale of a specimen covered by the control of trade in endangered species regulations
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) transported for sale

(A)_[a specimen]_
(B)_[specimens]_

of a species, namely **(..SPECIFY..), listed in Annex A to Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97 and in contravention of Article 8 of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(1) and (8) of the Control of Trade in Endangered Species (Enforcement) Regulations 1997.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
transport for sale a prohibited specimen
listed in Annex A to Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence should not be used for acts carried out after 30th September 2018; the Control of Trade in Endangered Species (Enforcement) Regulations 1997 are revoked by the Control of Trade in Endangered Species Regulations 2018 (SI 2018/703) from 1st October 2018.
(ii) See Regulation 8(3) and Article 8 of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97 for conditions required for legal purchase, sale etc of specimens.
(iii) See Regulation 8(4) for defence of lack of knowledge of protected status of a species listed in Annex A of Council Regulation (EC ) No 338/97.
(iv) See also associated offence wordings H2861, H2862, H2863, H2864, H2865, H2866, H2867 and H2868.

welsh.welshstandardoffencewording:

(A)_[sbesimen]_
(B)_[sbesimenau]_

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
